essence: Death-ender, love-crusher, Gaṅgā-crowned, meet-righter bowed.
Past sway, gnosis, dispassion, writs: no loftier haven cut off from you.
Unwished none crooks straw; wished all shoulder Brahmā's load.
Gem-crested wise bow to no Highest but Hara's.
Quiverless sweet mere mid knowing-sea dwelt in.
Askance-seen, fancy-strayed, last fruit granted whole.
None stronger virtned or stringless: bless or curse unsayable.
None fit to sip nectar-fruit, much less serve it, but you.
One begging from all-desire hoard: love of you solely.
Unbarred triple-kingship might hailed with its court.

sections.SUMMARY: Bunter of Yama, bruiser of Smara, river-crowned, righter. Prayer's perch towers past rule, ken, calm, canon; sundered from you, no shelter stands higher. Unbid, none buckles sedge; bid, all haul heaven's draught. Jewel-pated sages kneel to none Highest save Hara's. Still mere of honey mid mind's main sued for lodgement. Sidelong seen or dream-roamed, ripest meed dealt entire. Brawn or bareness none outranks; hail or hale unspeakable. Nectar yield none else may taste, let alone ladle. From the all-wish barn one alms craved: thee-love lonely. Unchecked triple-throne force cheered amid courtiers.

rasa.justification: Ender, crusher, hauler, dealer, crowner: powers pleaded to share power.

essence: Tat-tvam decided: none fails refuge.
Tasted and shed: highest seat hoped bright for the lover.
Dream doings foul or fair rested glad in dependence-pride.
Murktouch on mind's abode impossible as barren grandson.
Foot on kind release road: serving-Śiva wish stands.
Lone free might watches the triple weave.
Triple-smart unscorched saved: hail extinction-nectar mere.
Feigned love true-fruited: guileless crop pronounced by you.
Seeing-eye, reaching-road fruited from talk's wish-grove.
Better-than-good poise in you: refuge sweeping blocks.

sections.SUMMARY: That-art-thou settled: all flee in, none out. Fed full and mirage-shucked, top lodgement glints for the fond. Night deeds, clean or unclean, nestle glad in leant-on pride. Soot cannot smudge where mind courses his demesne — soon as the childless grandam's grandchild. One sole already on mercy lane hankers 'honour Hara'. Only strength, loose, looms the loom. Scorched by none of the three fires, the saved hail the still-sweet pond. Sham fondness fruits; straight fondness — crop unnamed till thou namest. Eye and highway yield from hearsay's orchard. Peak past prime poised aloft in thee: thou the broom of bars.

rasa.justification: Fleeing in, nesting glad, leaning proud, broomed clear: rest sought and given.

essence: Serving-Śarva savour ever-new each tick.
Untired fancy-teeming one, seamless, lords it unborn.
Lore-lamp licking birth-greased wont-wick: when presence?
Fault-outworn wink-lodging achieves all.
'Blest, quits, big am I' grounded fancy stands by you.
Self-doer of luck and muck; love mothers luck only.
Step in or self-clear? Man dangles; oversight alone decides.
Supervision-only grace is fulfilment, farthest seat.
Word, wit, work, frame gleam with love alone.
wish-jewel of praise heavy with granted longing, love's fortune-house — Nārāyaṇa wrought it for Śambhu

sections.SUMMARY: Wait on Sarva and sweeten hourly new. Unflagging fancy-hatcher stays simplex sovereign sans birth. When burns the wont-wick down to meeting? Blink once clean and command all. Gay vaunts of done-ness stand if thou prop. Thou turnest both wheels; thy love wheels only fair. Dangle between in-step and self-shine till sole survey settles it: mind's smile is siddhi, remotest room. Lip, brain, brawn, bulk gild with thee-love only. Longing-laden wish-jewel, love's fortune-house — teacher Bhatta Narayana built it for the Gracious.

rasa.justification: Ever-new, unwasting, only, remotest: closing gathers all prior hungers into one ornament.
